experiment.hypothesis: Replacing the starting backbone with WSP improves decision routing after identical training.

model.name: RikiyaT/Qwen3.5-0.8B-weight-space-programming
model.initialization: fresh backbone, fresh rank-16 LoRA and fresh decision head; never reuse Reflex-1 adapter

dataset.policy: reuse exact original rows, order, labels and splits; verify file hashes against training backup
dataset.test_policy: existing published cohorts are regression only; no test-based tuning; new independent final cohort for release
dataset.mixture_materialization: Pending original tools/train_combined_routing.py; exact 781 general rows and ordering cannot be inferred from counts and seed alone

training.target_modules: recover executed target selection from original trainer; released adapter regex in sources/reflex1-adapter-adapter_config.json
training.checkpoint_selection: same candidate steps and equal-domain validation mean as original; recover cadence/tie rule; do not force checkpoint 100
training.calibration: fit on separate original calibration partition only; recover procedure

evaluation.conditions: same cohort IDs/order/schema/options/state strings/runtime/precision/context/hardware for each matched arm
evaluation.baseline_policy: compare untouched backbones with same generative prompt; newly random decision heads are initialization diagnostics only

required_gates: recover exact trainer and data/config backup
audit original Unsloth base against official WSP parent
verify WSP edited tensor hashes before quantization
pin compatible environment and model loading path
execution.unknown_values: null means unresolved; config is not runnable and must not be filled with assumed defaults
